rules.statement: the campaign report is a fixed labeled-line block with conditional blocks (failure-evidence lines, suspect-queries block, manifest line variants) and a closing write-back confirmation
the workspace stub is frontmatter-only: same name and pre-existing fields plus the revised description, no body
a revised description is imperative, concise (1024-char cap), never first person, and free of failed-query keywords
a should-not query false-triggering under two or more structurally different framings IS a setup problem: stop the loop, surface it, draft nothing further

a should-trigger query failing under every candidate in every iteration is query-side: report it under suspect queries with signature and timeouts, recommend prune/rewrite; only a query that passed once may drive revision

excluded.reason: consume exit codes/JSON only — compliance-cost rule, pressure-testing track
prompt for missing inputs, never guess harness — compliance-cost rule, pressure-testing track
persistent campaign dir conventions — compliance-cost rule, pressure-testing track
12-step process guidance — how-to, no competing shape
sealed-pool no-exceptions table — pressure-resistance rule, pressure-testing track
query authoring guidance — how-to, no fixed artifact form
cite-the-phrase analysis method and categories table — how-to, no competing shape
mid-campaign source file never edited — pressure-resistance rule, pressure-testing track
abort policy — compliance-cost rule, pressure-testing track
cautions and documented facts — retrieval-testing track
campaign checklist — reference content, no rule to violate
